name: JOY UNSPEAKABLE
confidence: read from a public-domain score, unchecked
reviewNotes: The melody line read from the Timeless Truths score of Joy Unspeakable (https://library.timelesstruths.org/music/Joy_Unspeakable/, Joy_Unspeakable.xml, whose rights line reads “WORDS and MUSIC: Barney E. Warren, 1900. Public Domain.”), verse and refrain; only the tune was taken, not the harmony. Its opening agrees with hymnary.org's incipit 55113 11655 55671 (https://hymnary.org/tune/i_have_found_his_grace_is_all_warren). No hand fixes. The year 1900 is from the hymnary.org tune page and Timeless Truths; Warren's dates (1867–1951) are from hymnary.org (https://hymnary.org/person/Warren_BE).
